lessonTitle: How to build an AI Medical Affairs Operating System

slides.title: From Individual Tools to One Coherent System
bullets: This lesson integrates the module's tools into a personal AI operating system
A coherent set of tools, habits, and safeguards used consistently
Goal: amplify productivity without ever compromising rigor or security

slides.title: Match Each Tool to Its Best Task
bullets: Avoid the common error of using one generic tool for everything
Perplexity for initial, current landscape exploration
NotebookLM for deep work on a defined set of your own documents
Consensus, Elicit, and Scite for structured evidence search
Claude for long-document analysis, ChatGPT for strategic thinking

slides.title: Verification as a Habit, Not a Step
bullets: Every AI-assisted clinical claim is checked against the primary source
Applied before communicating anything to an HCP, without exception
Uses the evidence hierarchy and critical thinking criteria from Module 6

slides.title: Information Governance by Default
bullets: Know what data each tool's privacy settings allow you to enter
Follow internal organizational policy for every tool used
Apply precaution by default whenever data sensitivity is unclear

slides.title: Keep Your Own Knowledge Current
bullets: The generative AI landscape evolves at considerable speed
New capabilities, tools, and risks emerge constantly
Periodic time invested in updating tool knowledge protects your edge

slides.title: A Continuous Habit, Not a One-Time Project
bullets: Building this system is ongoing professional practice, never finished
Frees time for what no AI tool can replace
Expert scientific judgment, trusted human relationships, ethical responsibility

takeaway.title: A disciplined personal AI operating system amplifies an MSL without ever replacing human judgment
bullets: Match each tool to its strongest task instead of relying on one generic tool
Make source verification and information governance automatic habits
Keep updating your own knowledge as the AI landscape keeps changing
